visualCharacteristics: News listing grid of linked teaser cards; first 18 shown, a Load more button reveals 6 more per click.

contentPattern.structure: image, optional date tag paragraph, h3 with bold pretitle and title, text paragraph, link paragraph; optional last text-only row is the Load more label

reuseGuidance: Use for long teaser lists that need Load more; for a few cards use teaser-grid.
